headword: ショッピングセンター
reading: しょっぴんぐせんたー

definitions.explanation: A large retail complex housing many shops, restaurants, and often a supermarket under one roof, usually with a parking lot. Common in suburban areas.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ショッピングセンター⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A shopping center has opened nearby.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ショッピングセンター⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: On weekends we go to the shopping center as a family.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ショッピングセンター⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{映画館|えいがかん}→映画館：01024_eigakan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{入|はい}っている→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The shopping center in front of the station also has a movie theater inside.

notes:
Loanword from English. In Japan, often abbreviated to SC (エスシー) in real estate and retail industry talk.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧ショッピングセンター: large shopping center
- ショッピングセンター⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go to a shopping center
- ⟦{郊外|こうがい}→郊外：01403_kougai⟧{型|がた}ショッピングセンター: suburban-style shopping center

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ショッピングモール→ショッピングモール：27389_shoppingumooru⟧: shopping mall — usually a larger, more enclosed complex
- ⟦{商店街|しょうてんがい}→商店街：09391_shoutengai⟧: shopping street — a row of independent stores along a street
- ⟦デパート→デパート：01022_depaato⟧: department store — single building owned by one retailer
